delivery_cues.delivery_note: Bright corporate open, already a shade too calm.
delivery_cues.provider_text: Nine A M. At Cielo, another average day begins. The lights hum. Everyone smiles.

sections.label: hook
sections.text: Nine A M. At Cielo, another average day begins. The lights hum. Everyone smiles.

delivery_cues.delivery_note: Routine listing; let the last phrase curdle.
delivery_cues.provider_text: Coffee at nine fifteen. Keys handed over at ten. Every handshake warm. Every smile... held one second too long.

sections.label: escalation
sections.speaker_directions: Same smile, less air behind it.
sections.text: Coffee at nine fifteen. Keys handed over at ten. Every handshake warm. Every smile... held one second too long.

delivery_cues.delivery_note: Direct address. Slower. The narrator notices you.
delivery_cues.provider_text: The corridors are long today. Longer than yesterday. You have walked this hall before. Haven't you?.

sections.label: escalation
sections.text: The corridors are long today. Longer than yesterday. You have walked this hall before. Haven't you?

delivery_cues.delivery_note: Hush. This is the turn from satire to horror.
delivery_cues.provider_text: Do not mind the doors. They breathe when the building sleeps. Do not mind the humming. It knows your name.

sections.label: reveal
sections.text: Do not mind the doors. They breathe when the building sleeps. Do not mind the humming. It knows your name.

delivery_cues.delivery_note: The thesis. Land it like a stamp on a file.
delivery_cues.provider_text: Cielo builds homes for small families. And the homes... keep their people.

sections.label: reveal
sections.speaker_directions: Barely a whisper on the last three words.

title: Cielo: An Average Day (That Smiles Back)
